definitions.explanation: Joining or linking things together, especially physical objects like train cars. Also used in business for consolidated financial statements.

examples.japanese: {車両|しゃりょう}を{連結|れんけつ}する。
この{電車|でんしゃ}は{十|じゅう}{両|りょう}{連結|れんけつ}で{運行|うんこう}している。
examples.english: This train runs with ten cars connected together.

examples.japanese: {連結|れんけつ}{決算|けっさん}では、{子会社|こがいしゃ}の{業績|ぎょうせき}も{含|ふく}めた{全体|ぜんたい}の{財務|ざいむ}{状況|じょうきょう}がわかる。
examples.english: Consolidated financial statements show the overall financial situation including subsidiary performance.

notes:
USAGE NOTES:
{連結|れんけつ} is used in two main domains: transportation (coupling train cars) and business/finance (consolidated accounting).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連結|れんけつ}{決算|けっさん} (consolidated financial statements)
- {連結|れんけつ}{売上高|うりあげだか} (consolidated revenue)
- {車両|しゃりょう}の{連結|れんけつ} (coupling of train cars)
- {連結|れんけつ}を{解除|かいじょ}する (to uncouple, to disconnect)
- {連結|れんけつ}{子会社|こがいしゃ} (consolidated subsidiary)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{接続|せつぞく} (connection) is used for more general connections (internet, transport transfers). {連結|れんけつ} implies a physical or organizational joining together.
